facts.note: Transcript gives the same watch reading: at the temple's nine, Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine, and his uncle made a scene about it in front of everyone.
He went up to the library after dinner and stayed there alone. He heard the temple strike ten and did not look at his watch.

At eighteen minutes past ten by his watch he heard a thump right above him in the atelier. Then the repeater: ten slow deep notes, which he counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones, which he did not count.

At a quarter past ten by his watch someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door. At twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch someone came quickly down. He did not see who, and the door was shut.
His aunt's piano was playing downstairs when the thump came.
Girard came into the library at thirty-two minutes past ten by his watch, and they sat together until the temple struck eleven.
